question: Does the win-state goal-spec fix (f9a458e87) perturb enough cells versus its parent (aa8a38e31 + the seed shim) for a 12-cell banked-levels sign test to be able to detect anything? If not, that measurement must not be run.

WHY_THE_GRID_WAS_STOPPED_AT_2_OF_12: Not a resource decision. While it was running, review found a SERIOUS live bug in the very code path the treatment acts on: `_goal_satisfiability_check` returned `degenerate_goal_predicate` on BUDGET exhaustion, indistinguishable from a constant-false goal, so GOAL-REPAIR fired and SUBSTITUTED a looser non-winning proxy predicate. Every cell in this grid was therefore measuring a treatment sitting on top of a defect that is fixed in the same change (REQ-ARC-WMTE-6047). Continuing would have spent ~3 more hours characterising a configuration that no longer exists -- and editing the fix in mid-grid would have confounded the arms with intervening code, which is the exact error the retracted cross-experiment 'A/A' was retracted for. Stopping and re-running post-fix is the only sequence that yields an interpretable answer.

VERDICT.interpretation: PASS means only that the treatment perturbs enough cells for the planned sign test to be ABLE to reach significance. It does NOT mean the experiment is powered: perturbation is necessary but not sufficient for discordance on the endpoint. REFUSE means no possible outcome of the grid reaches alpha, so running it cannot produce a finding. INCONCLUSIVE means the probe itself is not finished -- cells are still outstanding that could carry it to a PASS -- so it is NOT evidence that the treatment is inert and must never be cited as one.

ARITHMETIC_STATE.reading: OPEN, not REFUSED: 1 attributable cell decided plus 10 pending is >= the 6 required, so the pre-flight had not settled when the grid was stopped. This artifact therefore reports INCONCLUSIVE. It is NOT a refusal and must not be cited as evidence that the goal-spec fix is inert.

WHAT_THE_TWO_DECIDED_CELLS_SHOW.vc33: ATTRIBUTABLE PERTURBATION. A/B PERTURBED (first divergence at action 4, 14 vs 18 actions) with the A/A byte-IDENTICAL over 18 actions -- so the harness demonstrably repeats itself on this cell and the treatment nonetheless changed behaviour. This is the first cleanly-attributable treatment effect measured on this path.
WHAT_THE_TWO_DECIDED_CELLS_SHOW.ft09: NO PERTURBATION (A/B byte-identical over 30 actions), and separately the A/A on this cell PERTURBED -- so even if the A/B had differed it could not have been attributed. Mechanistically consistent with the commit tightening a goal gate that was already refusing here: both arms ended `no_reachable_plan_after_refinement`.

PHASE_3_BANKED_LEVELS_NOT_RUN.why: Phase 3 was conditional on a PASS. The pre-flight did not reach a PASS -- it did not reach a verdict at all -- so running a 12-cell banked-levels measurement would have been the exact unpowered-grid spend the pre-flight exists to prevent.

KNOWN_LIMITS_do_not_over_read: max_inductions=1 and budget=60, so a treatment acting only at induction #2/#3, or only after a level-up deep in a 400-action run, is INVISIBLE to this probe. A future REFUSE from this design would mean 'not detectably perturbing within 60 actions and 1 induction', never 'inert'.

field_principles.inference_substrate: live_llm_inference: each cell loads and runs the 31B GGUF for a real induction, so the 60 s duration floor applies and per-cell wall times of 650-800 s are consistent with it.
field_principles.ARITHMETIC_STATE.still_arithmetically_op: Distinguishes 'we stopped early' from 'the answer is REFUSE'. Reporting an incomplete grid as a refusal would launder a process decision into a scientific finding about the treatment.
field_principles.PHASE_3_BANKED_LEVELS_NOT_RUN.submission: The submission gate requires beating a TRM baseline AND our best prior submitted score (0.12). Nothing here measured a score, so it is False by absence of evidence, not by a failed comparison.
